## Summary

<!-- One or two sentences: what does this change do and why? -->

## Type of change

- [ ] `feat` — new capability
- [ ] `fix` — bug fix
- [ ] `docs` — documentation only
- [ ] `test` — tests only
- [ ] `refactor` — no behavior change
- [ ] `chore` / `ci` — tooling, deps, pipelines

## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run verify` passes locally (lint, typecheck, format, test, build).
- [ ] Commits follow **Conventional Commits** (`feat:`, `fix:`, …).
- [ ] New `lib/` logic has unit tests in `tests/`; new routes have a Playwright case in `e2e/`.
- [ ] No fabricated metrics — any coverage/latency/badge numbers are **measured**, not hand-written.
- [ ] If this is an architectural change, an ADR is added/updated in `docs/adr/`.
- [ ] Docs/README updated if behavior or public APIs changed.
